items.claim: Overwrite with an object TType and a non-object TWith now yields TWith instead of a key-wise merge, so Overwrite<{ a: string }, undefined> changes from { a: string } to undefined, as the commit states.

The new regression test asserts only the middleware input path and the plain string input path, so the commit's Overwrite<string, number> and object-versus-primitive rules have no type-level assertion here.
